ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: StepAble uses the camera to analyze walkways and attach photos to issue reports.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: StepAble uses your location while the app is open to show maps, weather, and walking routes.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: StepAble accesses photos when you choose an image to attach to a report.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: StepAble saves a photo only when you request it.
